54	  "visual_prompt": "Square 1:1 photorealistic before/after split-screen supplement ad, recreating this exact layout. A thin white vertical line divides the canvas in two from the top band down to the benefit panel. PHOTO AREA (12.5% to 68% of the height), two equal photos side by side: LEFT 'before' photo — an adult woman about 27 years old with long wavy dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, medium shot from the head to the knees in a relaxed three-quarter view looking slightly over her shoulder, standing in a bright neutral bedroom with a white-sheeted bed and a wooden headboard, wearing a loose white cotton t-shirt and long gray cotton joggers, a tired, low-energy expression, flat cool daylight, slightly muted colors. No gym equipment in either photo. HERO PRODUCT: the attached product bottle, large, front-facing and perfectly sharp, standing centered exactly on the vertical dividing line, from about 20% to 68% of the canvas height, overlapping both photos, its base resting on the top edge of the benefit panel, soft studio light and a soft shadow. Product: A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; black label with a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner, a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh underline, three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' joined by plus signs, and '60 CÁPSULAS' at the bottom. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace, relabel or reinterpret it, and do not add any badge to it. REGISTRATION SEAL: a round white seal with a thin metallic fuchsia rim overlapping the lower-right side of the bottle (about 10% of the canvas width), with 'REGISTRO SANITARIO' curved along the top arc, 'INVIMA' in bold deep magenta in the center and 'RSA-0030271-2024' curved along the bottom arc. Card 3: icon of three ascending bars. Card 4: icon of a shield with a check mark. OFFER BAR (88% to 98% of the height): one wide, fully rounded pill bar across nearly the full width, deep magenta-to-wine gradient fill with a thin glowing fuchsia border; on its left part two stacked lines of text, the second line larger, flanked by three short bubblegum-pink burst lines on each side; a thin white vertical divider; on its right part a glossy pale blush pink (#FBE3EE) inner pill holding the price in huge heavy deep magenta (#B0105E) numerals. 77	    "The user's black bottle with fuchsia cap and fuchsia bottom band, large, centered on the divider",

79	    "Four rounded benefit cards with glowing fuchsia outlines and white thin-line icons (figure outline with circular arrow, hand with package, ascending bars, shield with check)",

90	    "Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements."

92	  "meta_policy_check": "All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
